Bulgaria Receives Remains of Czar Samuel After 1,000 Years

The remains of Bulgaria's Czar Samuel have been returned to Bulgaria after 1,000 years, following decades of negotiations between Greece and Bulgaria. The repatriation marks a significant historical moment for Bulgaria.
